attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The head line gives him «(; - 867)» and the body repeats it — «απεβίωσε εν ειρήνη το 867 μ.Χ.» — so a `death` is proposed, the folder carrying no `dates`. The entry is plainly him: a monk from childhood who learned the painter's art and practised it as a trade, hard on himself and self-controlled from his youth, merciful to the poor, honoured with the priesthood, a hard contender against all the heresies who suffered persecutions from the followers of Eutyches, Nestorius and Dioscorus and from the godless iconoclasts, sent to Rome to fight for the apostolic and patristic dogmas, back to Constantinople with great successes, taken ill on the road on a second journey to Rome, dead in peace in 867, his body translated and buried in the monastery of Euandros. No `locations` and no hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).
